targeted_mutation_checks.scope: four targeted mutation probes in disposable source copies, not a whole-package mutation score

source.digest_definition: Sorted package-relative POSIX paths and contents of .py/.json files, each NUL-terminated; includes uncommitted source.

manager.scope: Fresh interpreter package import; OS disk caches not flushed. Synthetic SQLite cache lookup/open, including executable checksum verification; no browser, network or install timing.

download.scope: Generated chunks, no network; tracemalloc excludes OS file cache and native-library allocations; not RSS

dependency_audits.caveat: No known advisories at the audit date, not proof of no vulnerabilities. The direct-minima audit is not a transitive locked-environment audit.
